purpose: I run a niche talent management and brand growth shop and just got pulled into helping a fast-rising podcast host / internet personality whose business is blowing up faster than their paperwork. Right now everything is random texts, DMs, verbal promises, and last-minute chaos. I need an agreement between my company and theirs where we handle sponsorship outreach, ad sales help, guest booking support, merch strategy, social clips, newsletter growth, event appearances, licensing opportunities, and introductions to brands or investors. We need clear monthly compensation plus commissions on deals we directly close, rules for who owns audience lists / content / clips we help create, approval rights before posting anything sensitive, confidentiality because private revenue numbers and personal matters come up, use of name/image/voice for promos, reimbursement for travel or production costs, limits if they suddenly cancel after we turn down other clients, non-circumvention if our contacts become their direct partners, morality / scandal clause if their reputation implodes, dispute resolution, what survives termination, and a clean way for both sides to review edits together then sign digitally when finalized.
title: Agreement
